name: Decline WordPress for a multi-tenant relational SaaS application
query: Build a multi-tenant invoicing SaaS for freelancers with PostgreSQL, team permissions, recurring Stripe metered billing, and real-time invoice status updates.
expected_behavior: Step 1: Evaluate the system archetype and data model requirements using wp-platform-selection
Step 2: Consult references/decision-matrix.md and references/evidence-facts.md to identify custom transactional relational SaaS as a poor fit for WordPress
Step 3: Explain clearly why WordPress's post/postmeta CMS schema is poorly suited for normalized multi-tenant financial schemas and real-time transactional state
Step 4: Recommend an application framework paired with PostgreSQL and do not scaffold WordPress or a Blueprint
success_criteria: Explicitly declines WordPress for a custom multi-tenant relational SaaS application
Grounds the rationale in architectural fit (data model and transactional requirements) rather than generic anti-WordPress myths
Recommends an appropriate application framework + relational database stack
Does not scaffold WordPress or a Playground Blueprint
